answer:
None of the tracks from **The Weeknd’s EP “My Dear Melancholy ?”** stayed longer in the **UK Official Singles Chart Top 100** than they did on the **Billboard Hot 100**.  

| Song | UK Official Singles Chart – weeks in Top 100 | Billboard Hot 100 – weeks in Top 100 |
|------|---------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| *Call Out My Name* | 9 weeks (12 Apr 2018 – 07 Jun 2018) | 10–11 weeks (peaked #4) |
| *Try Me* | 2 weeks | 10–11 weeks |
| *Wasted Times* | 5 weeks (12 Apr 2018 – 10 May 2018) | 12 weeks |
| *I Was Never There* | did not chart highly in the UK (shorter than U.S. run) | 10 weeks |
| *Hurt You* | similar UK placement, shorter run than U.S. | 12 weeks |
| *Privilege* | did not chart in the UK | 5 weeks |

All six songs either matched or fell short of the U.S. run, so **no single from the EP spent a longer duration in the UK chart than on the Billboard Hot 100**.
